note: Task.json-style breakdown for Epic 2 story subtasks. Planning only. Does not replace the main task.json rule of one formal task per story.

subtasks.title: Cloud auth module foundation
subtasks.description: Build the Go cloud auth module foundation for login, logout, token refresh, and session validation.
steps: Create auth service, handler, and repository skeletons
Define login request and response DTOs
Define token, session, and password policy interfaces
Connect logging and standard error handling

subtasks.title: Login API and password policy
subtasks.description: Implement the Go cloud login API, password verification, retry limits, and temporary lock strategy.
steps: Apply bcrypt password verification and strength rules
Implement failed login counters and lock rules
Return token, user info, tenant info, and permission summary

subtasks.title: Frontend login flow
subtasks.description: Build the React login page, form validation, login request flow, and global auth state management.
steps: Create the login page and form components
Handle errors, redirects, and route guards

subtasks.title: Local session cache wrapper
subtasks.description: Implement the Tauri local session metadata cache and clear flow without any local password auth fallback.

subtasks.title: User admin APIs
subtasks.description: Create user list, create, update, and enable or disable APIs in the cloud backend.
steps: Define user repository and service methods
Implement create, update, enable, and disable APIs
Add validation and standard error responses

subtasks.title: User admin UI
subtasks.description: Build the user admin list page, filters, create form, and edit form.
steps: Add name, employee code, department, and status filters
Show base profile and latest status

subtasks.title: Department and position domain model
subtasks.description: Define department tree and position data structures with CRUD APIs.
steps: Implement CRUD for departments and positions

subtasks.title: Department and position UI
subtasks.description: Build department tree management and position management pages.
steps: Support create, edit, and delete department flows
Handle node selection, order, and validation feedback

subtasks.title: Direct manager relation
subtasks.description: Add direct manager relation support with cycle checks and legal org constraints.
steps: Add direct manager relation to user model
Check circular manager chains and illegal cross-tenant links
Connect manager picker in the user edit form

subtasks.title: Three-layer permission model
subtasks.description: Design the base, department, and approval permission model and related tables.
steps: Define roles, permissions, user_roles, and role_permissions
Define resource mapping and permission names

subtasks.title: Permission center UI
subtasks.description: Build role list, permission matrix, and role authorization flows.
steps: Show permission sources for a role

subtasks.title: Fine-grained permission overrides
subtasks.description: Implement user-level permission overrides, data scope rules, and field-level restrictions.
steps: Support department-scope and self-scope data access
Support field hide and read-only rules

subtasks.title: Fine-grained permission UI
subtasks.description: Build the user-level permission override page and data-scope configuration flows.
steps: Show inherited role permissions versus user overrides
Configure data scopes and field-level restrictions

subtasks.title: Backend permission gateway
subtasks.description: Implement the backend permission gateway for tenant, role, scope, and field-level checks.

subtasks.title: Forbidden feedback UI
subtasks.description: Build unified frontend forbidden feedback including guard components, 403 pages, and apply entry points.
steps: Create 403 page and no-permission empty state
Show denial reason and required permission

subtasks.title: Org chart view
subtasks.description: Build the org chart page, department detail panel, and employee relation visualization.
steps: Show department detail and owner info

subtasks.title: Import preview and conflict detection
subtasks.description: Implement user import parsing, preview generation, and conflict detection.
steps: Define import template and field mapping
Parse uploaded files and validate structure
Detect duplicate accounts, employee codes, and org mapping conflicts

subtasks.title: Import commit and receipt
subtasks.description: Implement confirmed import execution, result receipts, failure details, and idempotency control.
steps: Implement commit endpoint after preview approval

subtasks.title: Import and export UI
subtasks.description: Build the import upload flow, preview UI, conflict prompt UI, and export range selection flow.
steps: Show preview report and conflict list
Support confirm action and result download
Support export by current permission scope

subtasks.title: Session model and timeout engine
subtasks.description: Build the cloud session model, idle timeout rules, and session state changes.

subtasks.title: Force logout and expiry handling
subtasks.description: Implement admin force logout, frontend session expiry handling, and automatic return to login.
steps: Implement session check or realtime notification
Clear auth state and local cache on invalid session
Show session expired and force logout messages

subtasks.title: Structured audit log model
subtasks.description: Define the audit_logs data model and audit writer wrapper for auth, permission, and bulk actions.
steps: Define event_type, resource, and result fields

subtasks.title: Audit event integration
subtasks.description: Attach audit writing to login results, permission changes, session revoke, and import or export actions.
steps: Attach audit to permission change APIs
Attach audit to session revoke APIs
Attach audit to import and export flows

subtasks.title: Audit query and export UI
subtasks.description: Build the audit page with filters, table view, and export support.
steps: Add filters for user, event type, and time range
Show resource, result, source, and trace_id

subtasks.title: API contracts and shared types
subtasks.description: Align Epic 2 API DTOs, error codes, permission response contracts, and frontend TypeScript types.
steps: Define standard error codes and 403 contract
Add personal profile view and update API contracts

subtasks.title: Integration and E2E coverage
subtasks.description: Cover login, session expiry, personal profile, user admin, permission denial, import or export, and audit query flows.
steps: Write frontend E2E auth and permission tests
Cover import, export, and audit regression scenarios
